_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} mu Mchezo wa Tic Tac Toe wa Anthu Atatu.
Chenjezo chako ni '{symbol}'.
Umakhala ukuyika chenjezo chako pa bodo la 5x5 ili kuunda mstari wa vinne.
Mistari inaweza kuwa ya mlalo, wima, kapena ya diagonal.
Tumiza zomwe lako kwa kutumia mfumo wa '[4]' ili kuweka alama pa seli ya 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chosintha cha mtundu wa move sichigwira ntchito. Gwiritsani '[cell]' pomwe selo ndi 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambala ya selo iyo njambura kwenelera: {cell}. Yikwenera kuŵa pakati pa 0 na {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} akhala symbol yake ({symbol}) mu ufa ({row}, {col}).
